recipes.title: Cookie Dough Baked Oats with Dark Chocolate
steps: Blend the oats, milk, banana, egg, protein powder (if using), baking powder and salt until smooth.
Pour into a deep oven-safe dish (it rises) and scatter the chopped dark chocolate on top.
Air fry at 180°C (350°F) for about 7 minutes, or bake in the oven for about 15 minutes, until puffed with a soft, cookie-dough middle. Careful, it's very hot.
recipes.notes: Estimated amounts and macros; the video lists the ingredients but not quantities. Leave out the protein powder for a softer, lower-protein version.
